text:
sam_infra: Heads-up — onboarding a new org that needs multi-cloud GPU capacity (AWS + GCP). Can we run through a condensed cross-cloud account init checklist so SREs and Sales know what to ask for?

maria_platform: +1. Need exact quota numbers, preferred regions, and IAM roles. Also whether they want Dedicated vs Private.

kai_enginfra: Quick list I use: org/project creation, billing link, tags/labels policy, IAM groups, service accounts, VPC peering/VPN options, default quotas to bump (CPUs, GPUs, ENIs).

jess_ops: For GPUs we should ask for target instance types and sustained qps — that determines vCPU and network quotas. Typical ask: 20x p4d or 40x a100 across us-west1/us-west2.

sam_infra: Customer said: ML training + inference. Wants low-latency inference in us-west2 and eu-west1, batch training in us-east1. Initial target capacity: 12 A100s for inference, scale to 48 for training bursts.

irina_sre: Important: GCP region mapping differs from AWS availability zones. For A100s on GCP it's us-west1-us-central1 combo often. If we're requesting quotas, request both GPUs and accompanying CPUs/GPUs per region. Example GCP request fields:
```
project: projects/<PROJECT_ID>
quota: GPUs (type = A100)
region: us-west1
amount: 12
reason: production inference for <CUSTOMER> - reserved capacity for dedicated pool
```

maria_platform: Also request following networking quotas at creation time or early PR: regional static IPs, forwarding rules, Cloud NAT concurrent connections, and subnetwork secondary IP ranges if using GKE. For AWS: ENI limits and Elastic IPs.

kai_enginfra: IAM snippets we hand out: create these groups: infra-admins, infra-operators, infra-viewers. Service accounts: model-serving-sa (roles: compute.admin, storage.objectViewer, kms.decrypt), metrics-pusher-sa (roles: monitoring.metricWriter).

sam_infra: Can we make a small template for the support request text for each cloud so Sales can paste it into support consoles?

jess_ops: Draft AWS quota increase template (short):
```
Subject: Request to increase Elastic GPU & ENI quotas for account <ACCOUNT_ID>
We are onboarding a customer (redwood-demo) that requires dedicated GPU capacity for inference and training. Please increase the following limits in region us-west-2:
- G4dn/A100 GPU instances (desired count: 12 region, burst to 48)
- ENIs per instance and overall account ENI limit to support high network concurrency
- Elastic IPs: +10
Reason: production inference DDoS-resilient capacity and scheduled training windows.
Contact: sam@redwood.com
```

irina_sre: And GCP template (short):
```
Project: <PROJECT_ID>
Quota type: GPUs (a100 / a2)
Region: us-west1, us-east1, europe-west1
Amount: 12, 24, 6 (respectively)
Also request: CPUs, Local SSDs, Static external IPs, Forwarding rules, and Internal IP address quota increases for subnets
Justification: Dedicated inference capacity + burst training for <CUSTOMER>. Production SLA required.
Contact: sam@redwood.com
```

maria_platform: Don't forget billing relationship — link billing account early and set spending alerts. Ask Sales to enable committed usage if customer will sign Dedicated. That can change how we request quotas (reserved vs on-demand).

kai_enginfra: Tags/labels policy: org:<ORG_NAME>, env:prod/staging, cost_center:<ID>, project:<PROJECT>. Make sure terraform bootstrap repo includes enforced label policy via org policy (GCP) and tag policies (AWS).

jess_ops: Regarding network architecture — do we want private interconnect or VPN for private deployments? For regulated customers we prefer private interconnect (dedicated) and will need bandwidth quota requests and VLAN attachments.

sam_infra: Action items summary?
- S1: Sales to confirm regions, target instance types, and committed capacity. (Owner: Sales)
- S2: Platform to submit quota requests using templates above to AWS/GCP. (Owner: sam_infra)
- S3: Infra to create org/project, link billing, and apply tag policy. (Owner: kai_enginfra)
- S4: SRE to pre-warm load balancers, reserve static IPs, request ENI/EIP increases. (Owner: irina_sre)
- S5: Security to approve service account scopes & KMS key provisioning. (Owner: maria_platform)

quota-bot: Reminder queued: submit AWS quota request before 2024-12-03 to avoid provisioning delays.

irina_sre: One more note — request soft limits first and ask for a gradual capacity ramp in support ticket if provider requests. That improves approval odds.

sam_infra: Perfect. I'll paste the templates into the onboarding doc and tag folks. If anyone wants to add a checklist item reply here and I'll include it. :thumbsup:
